---
title: "Shiki"
format:
  emiljs:
    shiki: true
    shiki-style: github-dark
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      # the unbundled language warns, which is the point of this deck
      noErrors: []
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'not available for highlighting.*nosuchlang'
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        # the keys reach emil.js, and the code stays a plain fence
        - ['shiki: true', 'shiki-style: github-dark', '\n``` r\n']
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        # highlighted with the embedded Shiki build (the same markup as
        # `emiljs build`), and a language outside the bundled set stays plain
        - ['<pre[^>]* class="shiki github-dark"', 'style="color:#', 'class="language-nosuchlang"']
---

## Highlighted code

```r
cars <- mtcars |>
  subset(cyl == 4)
```

```js
const x = 1;
```

plain text
